_comment: ICD_protocol.md v0.5; hex strings upper-case, no separators
bit fields (flags, status, faults, io, sys_flags, features, cleared): lists of set bit names (ICD tables); enums (motion_state, ...) by name
streams: feed chunks in order to a fresh parser (ICD §2.3); if idle_timeout_at_end, then signal a >= 20 ms inter-byte timeout
reencode = false: decoding gives 'decoded'; encoding 'decoded' gives canonical_payload_hex
framing_only = true: frame-layer test only, payload has no command semantics
decoded.value = 'INVALID_PADDING': decoders must reject the payload

crc16.name: ping_req_body
crc16.note: TYPE SEQ LEN_lo LEN_hi of ping_req

frames.name: get_info_resp
frames.description: GET_INFO response (44-byte INFO), hash = current params.yaml

frames.name: get_info_resp_longer
frames.description: INFO with 4 trailing bytes (future minor version): receivers ignore them

frames.name: get_status_resp_latched
frames.description: STATUS with E-stop, HALT (PC), PAUSED (button), faults LOAD_LIMIT + K1_WELDED, IWDG reset

frames.name: get_status_resp_paused_pc
frames.description: STATUS PAUSED by the PC PAUSE command (pause_src PC, D-29a / GF-01), not homed

frames.name: get_status_resp_drv_power_lost
frames.description: STATUS after driver power was lost with the E-stop closed (D-29c): NOT_ENABLED, HOMED cleared, DRV_PWR 0, no latch

frames.name: reboot_resp
frames.description: OK; FW resets <= 50 ms after the response

frames.name: get_all_params_p0_resp
frames.description: page 0/3 with all DEFAULT values, ascending id (conformance vector for the FW default table)

frames.name: get_all_params_p1_resp
frames.description: page 1/3 with all DEFAULT values, ascending id (conformance vector for the FW default table)

frames.name: get_all_params_p2_resp
frames.description: page 2/3 with all DEFAULT values, ascending id (conformance vector for the FW default table)

frames.name: set_param_range_nack
frames.description: E_RANGE, detail = parameter id; never clamped

frames.name: set_param_type_req
frames.description: SET_PARAM safety.link_timeout_ms with type byte u32 (parameter is u16)

frames.name: set_param_padding_req
frames.description: u16 value 1000 with non-zero padding byte -> E_RANGE (decoders must reject it)

frames.name: set_param_busy_nack
frames.description: SET_PARAM of a parameter without moving_ok while moving -> E_BUSY detail 1 (MOTION)

frames.name: set_param_config_nack
frames.description: soft_min_um >= soft_max_um (hard rule H1) -> E_CONFIG, detail = id of the other parameter

frames.name: load_params_nvm_nack
frames.description: LOAD_PARAMS without a valid NVM record -> E_NVM 1, RAM unchanged

frames.name: set_valid_resp
frames.description: t_us from which DATA frames (by their t_us) carry VALID = 1

frames.name: move_abs_req
frames.description: MOVE_ABS to 110.000 mm at 5 mm/s, accel 0 = motion.a_max_um_s2

frames.name: move_abs_neg_req
frames.description: MOVE_ABS negative target, minimum speed, large accel (field encoding)

frames.name: jog_pos_req
frames.description: JOG +2 mm/s, no bound (runs to the soft limit)

frames.name: jog_neg_req
frames.description: JOG -10 mm/s with bound 20.000 mm (SW travel limit, FW stops exactly there)

frames.name: jog_zero_req
frames.description: JOG 0 = controlled stop of a jog

frames.name: fault_clear_resp
frames.description: OK, body = mask of cleared faults

frames.name: pause_req
frames.description: PAUSE (GUI Pause): controlled stop + PAUSED latch

frames.name: pause_resp
frames.description: OK; PAUSED blocks motion until RESUME or HALT_CLEAR (D-30, D-31)

frames.name: resume_req
frames.description: RESUME (GUI Resume, D-31): clears only PAUSED

frames.name: resume_resp
frames.description: OK; PAUSED cleared, no motion starts (the SW re-issues the absolute target)

frames.name: resume_state_nack
frames.description: RESUME refused: HALT latched (e.g. STOP button pressed just before) -> E_STATE HALT, PAUSED and HALT both stay (D-31)

frames.name: move_abs_range_nack
frames.description: E_RANGE, detail = byte offset of the offending field (4 = v_um_s)

frames.name: move_abs_state_nack
frames.description: E_STATE, detail = BLOCK mask NOT_ENABLED | NOT_HOMED

frames.name: move_abs_paused_nack
frames.description: E_STATE, detail = BLOCK PAUSED: motion refused while PAUSED (D-30)

frames.name: move_abs_busy_nack
frames.description: E_BUSY detail 1: another move is executing

frames.name: estop_clear_cause_nack
frames.description: E_CAUSE_ACTIVE: E-stop sense input still open

frames.name: fault_clear_cause_nack
frames.description: E_CAUSE_ACTIVE: LIMIT_WIRING cause (both switches) still present

frames.name: home_confirm_nack
frames.description: E_CONFIRM: load above home.max_load_raw and no confirmed flag

frames.name: ping_internal_nack
frames.description: E_INTERNAL with implementation-defined detail (NACK form test)

frames.name: move_until_load_not_in_build_nack
frames.description: E_INTERNAL detail 1 NOT_IN_BUILD: command of a later milestone, feature bit 0 (OI-FW-21)

frames.name: data_typical
frames.description: moving, VALID, homed; header SEQ = frame_seq & 0xFF

frames.name: data_fallback
frames.description: fallback frame while the AFE is stale: afe_raw = 0x80000000, NO_AFE_DATA (FW-STR-005)

frames.name: data_saturated_pos
frames.description: positive rail 0x7FFFFF -> saturated, load limit tripped

frames.name: data_sync_in_payload
frames.description: payload and SEQ contain A5 5A patterns (parser must not resync inside)

frames.name: data_all_bits
frames.description: every flag and status bit set, t_us and frame_seq at their maximum

frames.name: data_wrap
frames.description: after t_us and frame_seq wrapped; OVERRUN = a frame was dropped in the FW before this one

frames.name: data_estop
frames.description: E-stop: not enabled, not homed, VALID cleared, driver unpowered (DRV_PWR 0, ALM)

frames.name: event_paused_button
frames.description: EVENT PAUSED by the physical button (arg 2 = BUTTON; GF-01)

frames.name: event_fault_set_k1_welded
frames.description: EVENT FAULT_SET K1_WELDED: E-stop open while driver power stayed present for 200 ms (drv.k1_weld_ms; value = ms, D-29c)

frames.name: event_stopped_drv_power_lost
frames.description: EVENT STOPPED cause DRV_POWER_LOST: driver power lost with the E-stop closed (D-29c)

frames.name: event_driver_disabled_drv_power_lost
frames.description: EVENT DRIVER_DISABLED cause 4 DRV_POWER_LOST (HOMED cleared, D-29c)

frames.name: event_boot_hardfault
frames.description: EVENT BOOT after a HardFault reset: value = faulting PC 0x08001A2C, value2 = CFSR 0x00008200 (OI-FW-21)

frames.name: data_bad_crc
frames.description: data_typical with the CRC high byte inverted -> dropped, crc_errors += 1

streams.name: bad_crc_then_good
streams.description: bad-CRC frame immediately followed by a good one

streams.name: garbage_prefix
streams.description: noise incl. lone A5 and A5 A5 before a frame

streams.name: split_chunks
streams.description: one DATA frame delivered in 3 chunks (1 / 5 / rest)

streams.name: len_too_large
streams.description: header with LEN = 0xFFFF then a good frame: len_errors = 1

streams.name: len_161_header
streams.description: header with LEN = 161 (one above the maximum) then a good frame

streams.name: sync_in_payload_good
streams.description: good DATA frame containing A5 5A, then PING response: both decoded, no errors

streams.name: sync_in_payload_corrupted
streams.description: corrupted DATA frame containing A5 5A, then PING response: the bad frame fails CRC, hunting resumes after its SYNC0, false syncs inside are rejected, the PING response is found

streams.name: truncated_then_stream
streams.description: first 15 bytes of a DATA frame, then two complete DATA frames: the truncated candidate fails CRC, hunting resumes after its SYNC0, both following frames are recovered

streams.name: two_frames_then_split
streams.description: two complete frames in one chunk, then a third split across two chunks

streams.name: truncated_then_idle
streams.description: first 15 bytes of a DATA frame, then a PING response, then line idle >= 20 ms: nothing is emitted until the inter-byte timeout, then the candidate is dropped and the buffered PING response recovered

streams.name: lone_sync0_at_end
streams.description: a frame followed by a lone A5 then idle: the A5 is kept until the timeout, then discarded without counting
